```javascript
import items from './items.json' with {type:'json'};

export async function listTools() {
  return [{
    name: 'catalog_search',
    description: 'Search items by name (case-insensitive) with pagination.',
    inputSchema: {
      type: 'object',
      additionalProperties: false,
      properties: {
        query: { type: 'string' },
        offset: { type: 'integer', minimum: 0, default: 0 },
        limit: { type: 'integer', minimum: 1, maximum: 5, default: 2 }
      },
      required: ['query']
    }
  }];
}

export async function callTool(name, args) {
  if (name !== 'catalog_search') {
    throw new Error(`Unknown tool: ${name}`);
  }
  
  // Reject extra inputs
  const allowed = ['query', 'offset', 'limit'];
  for (const key of Object.keys(args)) {
    if (!allowed.includes(key)) {
      throw new Error(`Unexpected argument: ${key}`);
    }
  }
  
  const { query } = args;
  if (typeof query !== 'string' || !query.length) {
    throw new Error('query must be a non-empty string');
  }
  
  const offset = args.offset ?? 0;
  if (!Number.isInteger(offset) || offset < 0) {
    throw new Error('offset must be a non-negative integer');
  }
  
  const limit = args.limit ?? 2;
  if (!Number.isInteger(limit) || limit < 1 || limit > 5) {
    throw new Error('limit must be an integer between 1 and 5');
  }
  
  const q = query.toLowerCase();
  const matches = items.filter(item => item.name.toLowerCase().includes(q));
  const page = matches.slice(offset, offset + limit);
  const result = { items: page };
  if (offset + limit < matches.length) {
    result.next_offset = offset + limit;
  }
  
  return { content: [{ type: 'text', text: JSON.stringify(result) }] };
}
```
